question: In a triangle ABC, what will be the value of a(b cos C – c cos B)?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

a(b cos C – c cos B)

**FORMULA USED:**

Cos C = ( a² + b² - c²) over 2ab 

Cos B = (a² + c² - b²) over 2ac 

**CALCULATION:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27aa47e6e61d14ab46f519f671b2f981ef78b582ac92cd58bd4ee0b29308f3cf.png] 

Here, we have a triangle ABC 

 Now, a( b Cos C - c Cos B ) 

⇒ a b Cos C - a c Cos B 

⇒ a b × ( a² + b² - c²)over 2 a b - a c× ( a² + c² - b²) over 2 ac 

⇒ ( a² + b² - c²)over 2 - ( a² + c² - b²) over 2 

⇒ ( a² - a² + b² + b² -c² - c²)over 2 = 2 × ( b² - c² )over 2 = b² - c² 

**Hence, the required value is b² - c²** **.**
